notes.title: September 2023 major version update plan
notes.content:
Hi, dear friends, we are CAT HEAD GAMES.

We have received much attention and support since the release of "Room In Dream". We really appreciated all the support, there is a long way to go and we will try our best to make the game better.

"Room In Dream" will have a major version update from September 16, 2023, including the addition and expansion of gameplay and features, as well as the addition of game content, such as: new items, playable instruments, new building functions ( allows you to create your own rooms), live wallpaper functionality, and more.

The update process will last for a period of time, with two to three continuous follow-ups and updates to complete the overall update. If you have any questions about game updates or game contect, please feel free to contact us, we highly value all your feedback and suggestions.

With sincerity to players and passion for games, all of us at CAT HEAD GAMES have devoted ourselves to improving "Room In Dream". We hope that you can truly feel healing and belonging, and the unique inner peace in "Room In Dream".

"Take a moment / Put the worries behind / Take in the beauty around / Let it relax your mind." ---By Abimbola T. Alabi

tags.feature: - new items
playable instruments
new building functions ( allows you to create your own rooms)
live wallpaper functionality
